## Failure paths and arms (fill in)

The same frozen candidate passed the native lifecycle and the converged-journal task-selection cases below. The self-contained [native summary](issue-226-native.json) records target/tool facts, actual exit codes and verdicts without depending on disposable transcripts or per-run drivers.

| Arm | Actual result |
|---|---|
| Converged key A baseline | Both synthetic users have exact A on both enrolled clients; four strict public-key SSH logins succeed; zero pending work. |
| Converged partial selection | `users` and `identity --skip-tags hosts` each return rc 2 at the exact unfinished-retirement preflight. Journal bytes, LDAP user/key state and host/DNS state remain unchanged. Both clients still accept A and reject B. |
| Selected retirement from converged state | Full cleanup removes the authoritative host and owned DNS A before a distinct receipt (`discharged=0`). Live B succeeds and A is denied; omitted desired/native state is preserved. Repeat apply is `changed=0`. Settled `users` and `client-cache` runs succeed with the same receipt, unchanged keys/hosts and zero pending work. |
| Optional/offline client | Actual reconcile returns rc 1 / SSH PARTIAL and retains exactly two user/retired-host pairs. The live client accepts B and denies A; the paused target is resumed. |
| Missing inventory / cross-stage | Each apply returns rc 2 at its intended pre-mutation guard; journal, LDAP and host/DNS state remain unchanged. |
| Direct absent / explicit recovery mapping | Direct roster cleanup records a separate exact receipt (`discharged=2`), preserves omitted-user state and repeats at `changed=0`. Inventory omission without mapping returns rc 2 without journal change; exact authorized mapping then succeeds. |
| Interrupted formal decommission | Authoritative LDAP first observes the host, then rc 32 absence before journal replacement is blocked with EPERM. Apply returns rc 1 with both pending pairs and inventory retained, and no receipt. After fault removal, the original persisted plan resumes to completed and removes inventory last; repeated resume is already-completed. Subsequent reconcile gives exact live C, C allow/B deny and preserved omitted-user state. |

Persistent file/directory fsync EIO remains helper/real-Ansible/provider harness evidence; the new settled-plan barriers reject it without creating files or changing journal bytes.

A command-package attempt initially failed before tests because shared tmpfs inodes were exhausted; a private mount namespace with disk-backed temporary storage passed. An isolated lint cache passed after stale shared-cache diagnostics. These unsuccessful environmental attempts are superseded by the recorded successful checks and receive no acceptance credit.
